mod_description:
[h1]Training Dummy[/h1]
Adds a buildable training dummy that crew members use during entertainment time to practice combat skills.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Melee training — unarmed or melee-weapon pawns lunge at the dummy, gaining Melee XP
[*] Ranged training — pawns with a ranged weapon fire at the dummy, gaining Ranged XP
[*] Mood boost — pawns gain the "Had Fun" thought after each session
[*] AI-driven — pawns choose to train autonomously during Entertainment schedule
[/list]

[h2]Requirements[/h2]
This mod uses GDScript for custom AI behaviors and requires [b]SpaceSlogModLoader[/b] to be installed.
[url=https://github.com/TinyPandas/SpaceSlogModLoader]Install SpaceSlogModLoader[/url]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] ~0.6 XP per session (roughly 1 in-game hour)
[*] ~40 days to gain a skill level at 2 sessions/day
[*] Competes with other entertainment options for schedule time
[/list]
